scenes.conflict: The beam scorches the terraces on a predictable cycle, and Concord wardens are trying to move Tamsin to a safer district while Mira has little time to act.
scenes.goal: Mira wants to measure the satellite's daily sweep and protect the outer canopy terraces.
scenes.outcome: Mira confirms that the sweep tracks the brightest solar installation once a day and that shielding alone cannot restore the burned gardens. She decides someone must find new seeds, and Tamsin offers to help.
scenes.summary: Mira and Tamsin watch the daily sweep burn the terraces. Mira's calculations show the damage is permanent unless the fields are replanted, and she begins to doubt that protecting the grid is enough.
scenes.title: Scorched Terraces

scenes.conflict: Oren is secretive and guilt-ridden over the Vault Sealing and fears repeating the old dispute. Mira is impatient and dismisses what her models cannot account for.
scenes.goal: Mira seeks the knowledge needed to find a source of seeds and persuades Oren to share what he knows.
scenes.outcome: Oren reveals that Emberroot Seed Vault still exists and that he remembers the route across the Wastes. He agrees to guide Mira, and Tamsin eagerly volunteers to come along.
scenes.summary: Mira climbs to Oren's greenhouse to ask about the old seed stores. After a tense exchange he admits he has held the vault's route in his notebooks all these years and agrees to go.
scenes.title: The Botanist in the Greenhouse

scenes.conflict: Halden insists scarce power must go into shielding the grid and sees the vault as a dangerous distraction. He privately knows shielding will not heal scorched fields but will not admit it.
scenes.goal: Mira and Oren want Concord support, including power cells, for an expedition to the vault.
scenes.outcome: Halden forbids the expedition and orders Mira to stay on the canopy. Mira and Oren resolve to leave without official support.
scenes.summary: At the Solar Assembly in Heliopolis Core, Mira and Oren plead their case. Halden denies them any resources and Oren's old rivalry with him resurfaces.
scenes.title: The Concord Refuses

scenes.conflict: Concord wardens are watching the gates and Tamsin is afraid of being left behind. Mira's rushed plans overlook details Oren points out.
scenes.goal: Leave Westerly unseen with shielded cases, filter-masks and sealed skins.
scenes.outcome: Tamsin guides them through the maintenance tunnels and they escape. Oren persuades Tamsin to stay and keep the seedlings alive, and she reluctantly agrees.
scenes.summary: With Tamsin's help the pair use the maintenance tunnels to evade the wardens. Mira packs shielded cases for the coming storm and says goodbye to Tamsin at the tunnel mouth.
scenes.title: Slipping the Wardens

scenes.conflict: Mirage storms and acid pools have changed the terrain. Oren's memory fails in places, and Mira rejects his plant-based readings in favor of her own calculations.
scenes.goal: Cross the first stretch of the Wastes toward Rustwake using Oren's remembered route.
scenes.outcome: Mira trusts her calculations over Oren's warning and the pair stumble into an acid pool. They are forced to retreat and shelter for the night, and they realize they need a guide.
scenes.summary: The pair struggle across salt flats and glassy fields. Mira's rigidity leads to a near-disaster, and Oren admits the route is beyond them without help.
scenes.title: Into the Saltglass

scenes.conflict: Kesh distrusts arcology folk and her elders demand a reckoning from the Concord before helping. She tests Mira, who has no authority to promise anything.
scenes.goal: Hire a Tidewright pilot to take them across the Wastes by sail-skiff.
scenes.outcome: Kesh agrees to pilot them if Mira promises to carry the Tidewrights' demand for a voice to the Concord. Mira makes the promise and the group sets out.
scenes.summary: In the shadow of Rustwake's rusting cranes, Kesh sizes up the two arcology travelers. After a sharp bargain and a skiff repair done with Mira's sun-lens craft, she agrees to guide them.
scenes.title: The Rustwake Bargain

scenes.conflict: Mirage storms hide the safe paths and Kesh, Oren and Mira disagree about which reading to follow. Mira's models clash with Kesh's and Oren's knowledge.
scenes.goal: Sail across the Saltglass Wastes through a rising mirage storm to reach the ridge above the vault.
scenes.outcome: Mira finally combines her lens work with Kesh's glint-reading and Oren's plant knowledge to find a safe path. The trio learns to work together.
scenes.summary: A mirage storm engulfs the skiff. Mira uses her sun-lens to signal while Kesh reads the crust and Oren identifies marsh growth, and together they find the route.
scenes.title: Skiff Through the Mirage

scenes.conflict: Kesh presses Mira on the Concord's closed gates while Oren is pressed to confess why he withheld the vault's location.
scenes.goal: Shelter safely overnight from mirage storms and toxic air and rebuild trust.
scenes.outcome: Oren admits his guilt over the Vault Sealing and Kesh begins to trust them. The three form a real partnership, while the satellite's sweep and the approaching storm leave less than a day.
scenes.summary: Sheltering in sealed skins, the three speak honestly about the gates, the Vault Sealing and the Seed Oath. Mira starts to see the Concord's choices differently.
scenes.title: Night in the Salt Shelter

scenes.conflict: The vault's solar array is failing and its seal can only be opened by hand, while Oren fears the responsibility of reopening it.
scenes.goal: Find and open the sealed entrance to Emberroot Seed Vault.
scenes.outcome: Oren opens the seal from memory and Mira restores a trickle of power with a hand-driven mechanism. They enter just as the first signs of the solar storm appear.
scenes.summary: At the ridge, Oren finds the hidden door. Mira rigs a shielded, hand-cranked mechanism to wake the failing array so the door can be opened.
scenes.title: The Dormant Ridge

scenes.conflict: The storm disables unshielded systems and the vault's array is failing. Time and carrying space are limited, and Oren fears repeating the old mistake.
scenes.goal: Protect the vault's electronics and the seed stores from the solar storm surge and choose which seeds to carry back.
scenes.outcome: Mira's shielded cases protect the seed stores and Oren selects the salt-tolerant and hardy species. They leave with seeds and Oren's knowledge, and Mira begins to trust other people's judgment over her numbers.
scenes.summary: As the storm surges, the trio work by hand to shield the vault. Oren chooses seeds and Mira rigs cases to carry them safely.
scenes.title: Storm Over the Vault

scenes.conflict: Mirage storms and the storm's aftermath hide the safe paths and the sweep follows its daily cycle. Kesh is pushed to take a risky shortcut.
scenes.goal: Sail the seeds back across the Wastes to Westerly before the next satellite sweep.
scenes.outcome: Kesh's piloting and Mira's sun-lens signaling carry the skiff through, and the seeds arrive intact.
scenes.summary: The skiff races home through storm-battered salt flats, with each of the three contributing their skill.
scenes.title: Race Back Before the Sweep

scenes.conflict: Halden arrives to enforce the ban, defending rationing, while the satellite's sweep approaches. Kesh demands that he answer for the closed gates.
scenes.goal: Show the Concord that the seeds, not shielding alone, can restore the scorched terraces, before the sweep burns more of the canopy.
scenes.outcome: Tamsin plants the first seeds in the scorched terraces and Mira's lens work deflects the beam enough to protect them. Halden sees his plan is insufficient and yields.
scenes.summary: With the beam about to sweep, Halden confronts the travelers. Mira, Oren, Kesh and Tamsin plant the first seeds and shield them, proving the vault's worth.
scenes.title: The Stand at Westerly

scenes.conflict: Halden must admit his plan was insufficient, and Kesh demands acknowledgment of the old closed gates.
scenes.goal: Win Concord support for a shared recovery and honor the promise made to the Tidewrights.
scenes.outcome: Halden opens Concord resources to the recovery and grants the Tidewrights a voice. Mira bridges the Concord and the Seedkeepers and Kesh becomes the Tidewrights' ambassador.
scenes.summary: At the Solar Assembly Halden concedes. The Concord, Seedkeepers and Tidewrights agree to a shared recovery.
scenes.title: A Shared Reckoning

scenes.conflict: The satellite still sweeps and the work is long. Oren must choose whether to rejoin the Seedkeepers and Tamsin must learn patience.
scenes.goal: Begin replanting Westerly's terraces and pass on knowledge to the next generation.
scenes.outcome: New seedlings take root in the terraces, Tamsin becomes steward of the gardens and Oren rejoins the Seedkeepers on his own terms. The community looks hopefully to the future.
scenes.summary: The four gather in the replanted terraces. Seedlings green under the mirrored light-wells and each character's arc comes to rest in a hopeful ending.
scenes.title: The First Green

logline: When a rogue weather satellite begins burning Westerly Greenhold and a solar storm approaches, a rigid young lens-engineer and a guilt-ridden botanist must cross the toxic Saltglass Wastes with a Tidewright guide to reopen a forgotten seed vault, defying a Concord that would rather shield the grid than save living things.
theme: Hope is rebuilt through trust, cooperation and care for living things.
title: Greenhold
